prompts.rotor: Create a single transparent production sprite for a 2D side-scrolling pixel game: ONLY a weathered windmill rotor viewed exactly front-on, complete circular centered hub, four wooden spokes and four faded cream linen sails, clockwork brass rivets. NO tower, NO landscape, NO backing disk, NO text. Square canvas, hub exactly center. Rotor diameter fills 94 percent of canvas. Sails form a balanced diagonal X, moderate gaps between sails, thin olive moss only at hub, lightly torn lower fabric edges but not overly ruined. Muted antique wood, slate blue gray metal and restrained pale straw canvas. Light from upper right, shadowed undersides. Fine deliberate pixel clusters and hard clean silhouette matching the small windmill in reference1 and the flat dark-blue terrain/olive grass in reference2, not painterly concept rock. Final native size384x384, detail appropriate to a44px player. This is a large but subdued background mechanical landmark, no high-contrast pure white or black outline. Transparent background with genuinely empty space between spokes. Entire four-blade assembly in one rigid plane suitable for slow rotation about central axle.
prompts.moss: Create ONE isolated small pixel-art hanging moss fringe for the edge of a grassy platform, transparent background, wide 3:2 canvas. A narrow horizontal top root mat across the central 85% of width, then three irregular fine wisps of olive moss dangling downward, longest off-center right, shortest at left. The root mat is flat and attaches to the UNDERSIDE of a grassy ledge; NO soil, rock, platform, branch, tree, flowers or separate floating particles. Quiet dark olive green with sparse muted golden highlights from upper right. Fine pixel clusters in Underworld style matching the grass edging in the TOP plains panel of the supplied reference. Final size80x52 native pixels, delicate and sparse negative space with transparent holes. Most of the moss stays in upper half, one thin off-center wisp reaches near bottom. Hard silhouette alpha without glow or drop shadow. This is a modest detail adjacent to a44px character, not a large foreground plant. No labels or borders.
